name: AI Shell
description: CLI that converts a plain-language request into a shell command, explains it, and lets you run, revise or cancel it.
whatItDoes: Helps developers who cannot recall exact command syntax by drafting the command and describing what it will do. A chat mode supports longer back-and-forth in the terminal.
howItWorks: A Node CLI sends the prompt to an OpenAI model and returns a command with an explanation. The user then chooses to execute, edit the request or abort. The key and other options are stored through a built-in config command.

requirements.name: OPENAI_KEY
requirements.description: OpenAI key stored with the config command

requirements.name: Node.js
requirements.description: Installed as a global npm package
